- [Runway Introduces Praxis-1 World Action Model for Robotics](https://mikhbar.website/en/robotics/runway-introduces-praxis-1-world-action-model-for-robotics/) (Robotics · October 3, 2026) — Runway has introduced Praxis-1, an open-weight world action model that transforms video pretraining into control for robotic systems across various embodiments.
